extension.description: Capture and inspect HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC and WebSocket traffic from VS Code terminals and debug sessions.
view.traffic.title: Tapline Traffic
view.welcome.certificate:
The Tapline root certificate is not trusted by the operating system; capture cannot start until it is.
[Install Root Certificate](command:tapline.installCertificate)
Installing prompts for your credentials. Remove it any time with [Uninstall Root Certificate](command:tapline.uninstallCertificate).
view.welcome.certificateTrust:
The Tapline root certificate is in the keychain but not yet trusted; capture cannot start until it is.
[Trust Root Certificate](command:tapline.trustCertificate)
Trusting prompts for your password. Remove it any time with [Uninstall Root Certificate](command:tapline.uninstallCertificate).
view.welcome.certificateTrusted:
The Tapline root certificate is trusted by the operating system.
[Uninstall Root Certificate](command:tapline.uninstallCertificate)
config.autoStart: Start capture when VS Code opens.
config.port: Port for the capture proxy. Defaults to 3606. Set to 0 to ask the OS for a free port.
config.ssl.hosts: Host patterns whose HTTPS traffic is decrypted (wildcards allowed). An empty list captures without decryption, and then no root certificate has to be trusted.
config.maxEntries: Maximum live transactions kept in memory.
config.maxBodyKiB: Maximum request/response body bytes retained per direction, in KiB. Traffic is forwarded in full; larger bodies are marked truncated.
view.welcome.stopped:
Capture is stopped.
[Start Capture](command:tapline.start)
Once running, new integrated terminals and debug sessions are routed through Tapline automatically.
view.welcome.running:
Capture is running; no requests yet.
[New Captured Terminal](command:tapline.openTerminal)
Run any curl, npm, pip or git command there, or start a debug session — requests appear here as they happen.
[Copy Root Certificate Path](command:tapline.copyCertificatePath) for tools that need the CA configured manually.
config.terminal.profiles: Which sets of environment variables every new terminal gets besides the proxy variables (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY). Each name stands for the variables a runtime reads to trust the Tapline CA; the resolved variables are listed below. Keep this generic and use "New Captured Terminal" for a runtime-specific terminal.
config.mcp.enabled: Serve an MCP endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp) so AI assistants such as Copilot, Claude Code and Cursor can read and replay captured traffic.
config.mcp.port: Loopback port of the MCP endpoint.
config.grpc.protoFiles: Glob patterns (relative to the workspace) or absolute paths of .proto files used to decode gRPC messages with field names. Without a matching schema, messages are decoded by field number.
config.rules: Interception rules, applied in order to matching requests: `breakpoint` pauses for editing, `rewrite` changes method / URL / status / headers / body, `mapLocal` answers with a file or inline body, `mapRemote` sends the request to another origin, `block` refuses it, `throttle` adds latency and caps bandwidth. Edit them in the traffic panel (Rules) or here.
config.rules.headers: Header values to set; null removes the header.
config.rules.kind.breakpoint: Pause matching requests/responses so they can be edited before continuing.
config.rules.kind.rewrite: Change the method, URL, status, headers or body.
config.rules.kind.mapLocal: Answer with a file or inline body without contacting the server.
config.rules.kind.mapRemote: Send the request to another origin.
config.rules.kind.block: Refuse the request with an error status.
config.rules.url: Wildcard URL pattern (* matches anything); without * it is a prefix; empty matches every URL.
config.rules.request: breakpoint: pause requests (boolean); rewrite: edits applied to the request.
config.rules.response: breakpoint: pause responses (boolean); rewrite: edits applied to the response.
config.rules.file: mapLocal: file served as the response, relative to the workspace or absolute.
config.rules.body: mapLocal: inline body served when no file is set.
config.rules.to: mapRemote: origin (scheme://host[:port], optional path prefix) the request is sent to instead.
